assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game-interface border, a single reusable nine-slice panel frame for a cosmic-horror deep-sea fantasy roleplaying app. Create one square image, front-facing orthographic. The frame is four straight rails of slick, wet, black-green carved stone, cut in long shallow facets whose angles do not quite agree with each other, so the geometry feels subtly wrong while the rails stay straight; thin trails of dark sea weed cling to the stone here and there; a fine incised groove runs along each rail with a very faint cold phosphor-green sheen in it. At each of the four corners a plain square stone block carved with three concentric incised rings. Material depth, wet specular highlights, pitted eroded edges, soft dimensional shading: the tactile artistic UI craft of a classic fantasy strategy game, not a flat vector border. Frame aligned square to the canvas, no perspective. Each rail stays narrow, within the outer 12 percent of the image; corner blocks may fill the outer 18 percent. Keep the middle stretches of all four rails simple and continuous so they can stretch in a responsive UI. BACKGROUND: the large rectangular central opening (the central 64 percent in each dimension) and the thin space outside the frame must be filled with perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta #FF00FF, with no texture, no shadow, no gradient and no ornaments crossing it, so it can be keyed out to transparency. Frame nearly fills the canvas with a 3 percent magenta outer margin; nothing cropped. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere in the frame itself. Soft neutral top-left light, black-green stone, cold sea green, no bronze, no gold, no shells. No creatures, no tentacles, no faces, no words, no letters, no runes that look like writing, no buttons, no icons, no scenery, no watermark.
